english.title: Fail to comply with a litter abatement order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with a litter abatement order made by the **(..NAME OF MAGISTRATES' COURT..) Magistrates' Court on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) by **(..SPECIFY THE FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 91(9) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: In any proceedings for an offence under section 91(9) it is a defence for the defendant to prove that he has complied, as respects the highway or land in question, with his duty under section 89(1) and (2).
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with a litter abatement order made by the **(..NAME OF MAGISTRATES' COURT..) Magistrates' Court on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) by **(..SPECIFY THE FAILURE..).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note:
A further fine of an amount equal to one-twentieth of that level for each day on which the offence continues after the conviction.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level four on the legislative standard scale

libra.complexpenaltydetails: A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale together with a further fine of an amount equal to one-twentieth of that level for each day on which the offence continues after the conviction
